y_true.description: The ground truth values. `y_true` values are expected to be either `{-1, +1}` or `{0, 1}` (i.e. a one-hot-encoded tensor) with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.

y_pred.description: The predicted values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.

output.description: Categorical hinge loss values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN-1]`.
